findings.issue: Bare 'แดชบอร์ด' violates contract terminology.banned_forms entry 'แดชบอร์ด (เดี่ยว)'. Not caught by lint_thai_writing.py, whose only แดชบอร์ด-related lexicon entry bans an unrelated metaphor ('หน้ากากแดชบอร์ดโดยไร้เครื่องยนต์ข้อมูล'). A genuine, unambiguous contract-terminology gap independent of mechanical coverage -- exactly what independent review exists to catch.
findings.disposition: Flag for human correction before publication (e.g. 'เว็บแอปพลิเคชันหรือระบบแสดงผลข้อมูลที่เชื่อมกับระบบบัญชีข้อมูล'); does not block this pass verdict per rubric rule 5 since it is a single local word-choice defect that does not change governing meaning.

findings.issue: Contract required_structures specifies a 3-group user-impact list, but argument-map unit arg-02's own grounds and application_to_design commit to 4 distinct user groups (central policymakers; regional/local officers; private sector; public/community). The draft merges private-sector and public/community into one bullet to satisfy the contract's literal count. Both underlying findings are stated as separate clauses within the merged bullet -- nothing is dropped -- but they rest on different grounds and imply different design responses, so the merge flattens some legibility at the list-item level.
findings.disposition: Defensible reconciliation of a genuine pre-existing contract/map inconsistency, executed transparently. Recommend reconciling the contract's required_structures text with the map's 4-group finding at the next writing-plan revision, rather than leaving this mismatch for future drafters to resolve unilaterally each time.
